[[Category:Northwood Cemetery, Logan County, Ohio]]
== Biography ==
Moses married Mary J. Pierce of Cincinnati on 05-November-1839. They had three children: Lois Ladd, Robert Finley, and John Cameron (died at 5 months). Mary J. Pierce died of consumption on 14-March-1846. The children were cared for by their aunt, Mary Glasgow of Pittsburgh.

Moses later married Martha W. Thompson of Pittsburgh in 1848. Children from this marriage were: Mary J., Clara T. Peninnah T., and William M.

In August 1879 he married a third time, to Mary Cavin of McKeesport, Pennsylvania, 

Many details about Moses and his family are included In a [https://www.wikitree.com/photo.php/0/0a/Glasgow-590.pdf History of the Glasgow Family] written by [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-590 William Melanchthon Glasgow].
== Research Notes ==
=== Father confidence review — 26 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-209]] is assessed at **94% (confident)** for Moses Thomas Glasgow. Page 4 of the family history states: “The fourth child and third son of John Glasgow was my father,” explicitly identifying Moses as John’s son. Page 5 gives Moses’s Mary J. Pierce and Martha W. Thompson marriages and his death on 13 January 1892. The distinctive family sequence matches Glasgow-589’s captured 29 October 1809 Bakerstown birth and 13 January 1892 death.

This is a qualified retrospective family-account assessment, not contemporary birth-record proof. The six-page typescript is undated, attributed to William Melanchthon Glasgow, and contains known date errors elsewhere. The “father died” wording is retained as source wording and does not alter John-209’s life dates. No new father attachment, vital-field edit, or live WikiTree change is claimed. Moses’s maternity and John-209’s own parentage remain separate questions.

=== Earlier father review — 22 October 2026 (superseded) ===

The earlier assessment was **68% (probable)**, based on chronology and the family account’s marriage/children passage before the explicit parent paragraph was inspected. Its assessment history remains preserved in the structured record; this review supersedes it.

=== William Melanchthon Glasgow father review — 27 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-589]] is assessed at **96% (confident)** for William Melanchthon Glasgow. The original 1888 [https://archive.org/details/historyofrefor00glas/page/526/mode/1up *History of the Reformed Presbyterian Church in America*] biography on page 526 states that William was the son of “Moses T.” and “Martha W. (Thompson),” matching the retained Glasgow-590 profile and the page-5 child group in the family history. The source is a published biography attributed to the same family author represented by the family-history PDF, so it is not an independent witness. It supports the existing father relationship; no attachment, vital-field, or live change is made.

The page gives William’s birth as 1 July 1856, conflicting with the retained 5 July 1856 Youngstown date. That discrepancy is not resolved here and no field is changed. Moses is described in the reviewed family material as a carpenter and ruling elder, not a minister; prior ministerial searches are not evidence for this identity.
